contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.text: If you need help building or improving a web project, have a collaboration idea, or just have questions – I’m always available!
contact.textSecond: You can reach me via email or social media, or use the form on the right to send me a message directly. I try to respond as quickly as possible.
contact.textWait: Looking forward to hearing from you! 🚀
contact.hrTitle: If you're an HR professional looking to offer me an exciting opportunity, feel free to drop me a message, or simply download my CV for more details.

projects.githubFinder: An application that allows you to find a user by their username and display all their repositories. Uses the GitHub API to fetch data.

about.text: Hi, I’m Vitaly. Originally from a small village, now I’m living in the USA and making the web a better place one website at a time. I’ve been a frontend developer since 2019, focusing on clean, functional code and user-friendly designs. I’m passionate about building websites that not only look great but also work perfectly. Let’s create something amazing together!
